$comment: Per-dialect capability descriptor. An agent reads this AFTER the http-mcp `transports` tool tells it gRPC is adapter-provided. Declares how this dialect maps down onto the wire's two atoms.
why_not_wire: The .proto and length-prefixed framing are application semantics, not raw bytes. Putting HTTP/2+protobuf in the wire would break stdlib-only leanness, so the adapter owns them and presents CALL/CHANNEL upward.
shape_proven_by: grpc_test.go — unary=CALL, server-stream=CHANNEL over real HTTP/2; own both ends, stdlib (no protoc/grpc-lib). Full protobuf/HPACK/deadlines remain the adapter's job.
